remarks: Totally updated, beautiful, Open Concept home with 3-5BRs and 2.5 Baths. Main floor- 3 Bedrooms, Living Room, Dining Room, 1.5 Bath, Stunning Kitchen with quartz countertops and new SS appliances. Walkout, Bright Lower Level- 2 Bedrooms/ Office Rooms, Large Family Room with Wet Bar and storage cabinets, 1 Full Bathroom, Laundry Room. Updated features include- newly paved driveway, new roof & siding, New doors, Refinished Hardwood floors, Recessed lighting throughout. Nice yard and Shed for Storage. Right off Norwalk Connecticut Ave, Convenience to I-95, Near by Best Buy, TJ Maxx, Costco, Home Depot, Mc Donald, Banks and Restaurants. Looking for a very clean and well maintained tenant.
